arxiv-2006-04202.title: Probabilistic Timed Automata with One Clock and Initialised Clock-Dependent Probabilities
arxiv-2006-04202.creator: Jeremy Sproston
arxiv-2006-04202.description: Abstract . Clock-dependent probabilistic timed automata extend classical timed automata with discrete probabilistic choice, where the probabilities are allowed to depend on the exact values of the clocks. Previous work has shown that the quantitative reachability problem for clock-dependent probabilistic timed automata with at least three clocks is undecidable.

arxiv-2012-00744.title: A Framework and Dataset for Abstract Art Generation via CalligraphyGAN
arxiv-2012-00744.creator: Jinggang Zhuo, Ling Fan, Harry Jiannan Wang
arxiv-2012-00744.description: Abstract 1 Introduction With the advancement of deep learning, artificial intelligence (AI) has made many breakthroughs in recent years and achieved superhuman performance in various tasks such as object detection, reading comprehension, and video games. Generative Modeling such as various Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) [ 4 ] models has been applied to generate paintings and music.

arxiv-2101-05733.title: DESY 21-003
arxiv-2101-05733.creator: DO-TH 21/01
arxiv-2101-05733.description: Abstract We calculate the polarized massive operator matrix element A g ​ q ( 3 ) ​ ( N ) A_{gq}^{(3)}(N) to 3-loop order in Quantum Chromodynamics analytically at general values of the Mellin variable N N both in the single- and double-mass case in the Larin scheme.

arxiv-2102-00588.title: Stochastic Geometry Analysis of Spatial-Temporal Performance in Wireless Networks: A Tutorial Thanks: X. Lu and H. Jiang are with the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Alberta, Canada. M. Salehi and E. Hossain are with the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineer
arxiv-2102-00588.creator: Xiao Lu, Member, IEEE, Mohammad Salehi, Martin Haenggi, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-2102-00588.description: Abstract The performance of wireless networks is fundamentally limited by the aggregate interference, which depends on the spatial distributions of the interferers, channel conditions, and user traffic patterns (or queueing dynamics). These factors usually exhibit spatial and temporal correlations and thus make the performance of large-scale networks environment-dependent (i.e., dependent on network topology, locations of the blockages, etc.).

arxiv-2103-06688.title: On the Computational Efficiency of Catalyst Accelerated Coordinate Descent Thanks: D.A. Pasechnyuk’s research was supported by the A.M. Raigorodsky Scholarship in the field of optimization and RFBR grant 19-31-51001 (Scientific mentoring). The work of V.V. Matyukhin was supported by the Ministry of
arxiv-2103-06688.creator: Dmitry Pasechnyuk, Vladislav Matyukhin
arxiv-2103-06688.description: Abstract This article is devoted to one particular case of using universal accelerated proximal envelopes to obtain computationally efficient accelerated versions of methods used to solve various optimization problem setups. We propose a proximally accelerated coordinate descent method that achieves the efficient algorithmic complexity of iteration and allows taking advantage of the data sparseness.

arxiv-2112-09225.title: The strong-field QED experiment LUXE at the European XFEL and its detector challenges
arxiv-2112-09225.creator: for the LUXE Collaboration
arxiv-2112-09225.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by for the LUXE Collaboration. The LUXE experiment aims at studying high-field QED in electron-laser and photon-laser interactions, with the 16.5 GeV electron beam of the European XFEL and a laser beam with power of up to 350 TW. The experiment will measure the spectra of electrons and photons in non-linear Compton scattering where production rates in excess of 10 9 10^{9} are expected per 1 Hz bunch crossing.

arxiv-2204-11998.title: BeAGLE: Benchmark e e A Generator for LEptoproduction in high energy lepton-nucleus collisions
arxiv-2204-11998.creator: Wan Chang, Elke-Caroline Aschenauer, Mark D. Baker, Alexander Jentsch, Jeong-Hun Lee, Zhoudunming Tu, Zhongbao Yin, Liang Zheng
arxiv-2204-11998.description: Abstract The upcoming Electron-Ion Collider (EIC) will address several outstanding puzzles in modern nuclear physics. Topics such as the partonic structure of nucleons and nuclei, the origin of their mass and spin, among others, can be understood via the study of high energy electron-proton ( e ​ p ep ) and electron-nucleus ( e e A) collisions.

arxiv-2301-08916.title: On the status of the star Schulte 12 in the association Cyg OB2
arxiv-2301-08916.creator: V.G. Klochkova, E.S. Islentieva, V.E. Panchuk Special Astrophysical Observatory, Nizhnij Arkhyz, 369167 Russia
arxiv-2301-08916.description: Abstract High-resolution spectra of the LBV candidate Schulte 12 in the Cyg OB2 association were obtained at the 6-meter BTA telescope with the NES echelle spectrograph on the arbitrary dates in 2001–2022. Variability of the emission profile of H α \alpha and absorptions of He I, Si II with time was found.

arxiv-2307-05045.title: Stationary striations in plasma, created by a short microwave pulse in a waveguide filled with a neutral gas
arxiv-2307-05045.creator: Y. Bliokh, Y. Cao, V. Maksimov, A. Haim, J.G. Leopold, A. Kostinsky, Ya.E. Krasik
arxiv-2307-05045.description: Abstract It was observed experimentally that after crossing a waveguide filled with a neutral gas, a short powerful microwave pulse leaves a periodic glow of plasma along the waveguide, persisting several tens of nanoseconds. A theoretical model is presented which in combination with numerical simulations proposes a possible explanation of this novel phenomenon.

arxiv-2307-15985.title: Inequalities among two rowed immanants of the q q -Laplacian of Trees and Odd height peaks in generalized Dyck paths
arxiv-2307-15985.creator: Arbind Kumar Lal, Mukesh Kumar Nagar, Sivaramakrishnan Sivasubramanian
arxiv-2307-15985.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Arbind Kumar Lal, Mukesh Kumar Nagar, Sivaramakrishnan Sivasubramanian. arxiv-2312-02231.title: Quality Diversity in the Amorphous Fortress (QD-AF): Evolving for Complexity in 0-Player Games
arxiv-2312-02231.creator: Sam Earle, M Charity, Dipika Rajesh, Mayu Wilson, Julian Togelius
arxiv-2312-02231.description: Abstract We explore the generation of diverse environments using the Amorphous Fortress (AF) simulation framework. AF defines a set of Finite State Machine (FSM) nodes and edges that can be recombined to control the behavior of agents in the ‘fortress’ grid-world.

arxiv-2411-11415.title: The ballistic limit of the log-Sobolev constant equals the Polyak–Łojasiewicz constant
arxiv-2411-11415.creator: Sinho Chewi, Austin J. Stromme
arxiv-2411-11415.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Sinho Chewi, Austin J. Stromme. The Polyak–Łojasiewicz (PL) constant of a function f : ℝ d → ℝ f\colon\mathbb{R}^{d}\to\mathbb{R} characterizes the best exponential rate of convergence of gradient flow for f f , uniformly over initializations. Meanwhile, in the theory of Markov diffusions, the log-Sobolev (LS) constant plays an analogous role, governing the exponential rate of convergence for the Langevin dynamics from arbitrary initialization in the Kullback–Leibler divergence.

arxiv-2412-02698.title: Scaling BERT Models for Turkish Automatic Punctuation and Capitalization Correction PubID: pubid: 979-8-3503-7943-3/24/$31.00 ©2024 IEEE
arxiv-2412-02698.creator: Abdulkader Saoud, Mahmut Alomeyr, Himmet Toprak Kesgin, Mehmet Fatih Amasyali
arxiv-2412-02698.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Abdulkader Saoud, Mahmut Alomeyr, Himmet Toprak Kesgin, Mehmet Fatih Amasyali. This paper investigates the effectiveness of BERT-based models for automated punctuation and capitalization corrections in Turkish texts across five distinct model sizes. The models are designated as Tiny, Mini, Small, Medium, and Base. The design and capabilities of each model are tailored to address the specific challenges of the Turkish language, with a focus on optimizing performance while minimizing computational overhead.

It is shown that the moment matrix is the only such valuation if n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 , while a new functional shows up in dimension two. 1.

arxiv-2503-14210.title: BLOW-UP OF RADIALLY SYMMETRIC SOLUTIONS FOR A CUBIC NLS TYPE SYSTEM IN DIMENSION 4
arxiv-2503-14210.creator: MAICON HESPANHA, ADEMIR PASTOR
arxiv-2503-14210.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with a cubic nonlinear Schorödinger system modeling the interaction between an optical beam and its third harmonic in a material with Kerr-type nonlinear response. We are mainly interested in the so-called energy-critical case, that is, in dimension four.

arxiv-2504-02962.title: Level Up Peer Review in Education
arxiv-2504-02962.creator: Rafal Wlodarski, Leonardo da Silva Sousa, Allison Connell Pensky
arxiv-2504-02962.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rafal Wlodarski, Leonardo da Silva Sousa, Allison Connell Pensky. In software engineering (SE), the ability to review code and critique designs is essential for professional practice. However, these skills are rarely emphasized in formal education, and peer feedback quality and engagement can vary significantly among students. This paper introduces Socratique, a gamified peer-assessment platform integrated with Generative AI (GenAI) assistance, designed to develop students’ peer-review skills in a functional programming course.

arxiv-2504-05848.title: Relativistic limits on the discretization and temporal resolution of a quantum clock
arxiv-2504-05848.creator: Tommaso Favalli
arxiv-2504-05848.description: Abstract We provide a brief discussion regarding relativistic limits on the discretization and temporal resolution of time values in a quantum clock. Our clock is characterized by a time observable chosen to be the complement of a bounded and discrete Hamiltonian which can have an equally-spaced or a generic spectrum.

arxiv-2505-11534.title: Empirical Performance Evaluation of Lane Keeping Assist on Modern Production Vehicles
arxiv-2505-11534.creator: Yuhang Wang 1 Abdulaziz Alhuraish 2 yuhangw@usf.edu aalhuraish@usf.edu Shuyi Wang 3 Hao Zhou 4 * syw@fzu.edu.cn haozhou1@usf.edu
arxiv-2505-11534.description: Abstract Leveraging a newly released open dataset of Lane Keeping Assist (LKA) systems from production vehicles, this paper presents the first comprehensive empirical analysis of real-world LKA performance. Our study yields three key findings: (i) LKA failures can be systematically categorized into perception, planning, and control errors.

arxiv-2508-00072.title: Coexistence of Entanglement-based Quantum Channels with DWDM Classical Channels over Hollow Core Fibre in a Four Node Quantum Communication Network Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2508-00072.creator: Marcus J Clark 1,2,*, Obada Alia 1,4, Sima Bahrani 1, Gregory T Jasion 3, Hesham Sakr 3, Periklis Petropoulos 3, Francesco Poletti 3, George T Kanellos 1,6, John Rarity 2, Reza Nejabati 1,5, Siddarth K Joshi 2,†, Rui Wang 1,‡, Dimitra Simeonidou 1
arxiv-2508-00072.description: Abstract We experimentally demonstrate the coexistence of three entanglement-based quantum channels with carrier-grade classical optical channels over 11.5 11.5 km hollow core nested antiresonant nodeless fibre, in a four user quantum network. A transmission of 800 Gbps is achieved with four classical channels simultaneously with three quantum channels all operating in the C-band with a separation of 1.2 1.

arxiv-2510-21539.title: Direct test for critical slowing down before Dansgaard-Oeschger events via the volcanic climate response
arxiv-2510-21539.creator: Johannes Lohmann
arxiv-2510-21539.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Johannes Lohmann. It is tested whether past abrupt climate changes support the validity of statistical early-warning signals (EWS) as predictor of future climate tipping points. EWS are expected increases in amplitude and correlation of fluctuations driven by noise. This is a symptom of critical slowing down (CSD), where a system’s recovery from an external perturbation becomes slower as a tipping point (represented by a bifurcation) is approached.

arxiv-2604-04938.creator: Enso O. Torres Alegre *, Diana E. Mora Jiménez

pmc-10723013.title: Ngaramadhi Space: An Integrated, Multisector Model of Care for Students Experiencing Problematic Externalising Behaviour
pmc-10723013.creator: Santuri Rungan, Susan Gardner, Huei-Ming Liu, Susan Woolfenden, Jennifer Smith-Merry, John Eastwood
pmc-10723013.description: Introduction:Behavioural and emotional disorders are a significant cause of morbidity for young people aged 10–19 years. School-based health care (SBHC) provides an innovative approach to addressing these issues within Australia.Description:We describe an innovative and integrative SBHC model called Ngaramadhi Space (NS) based at a specialised behavioural school called Yudi Gunyi school (YGS) in metropolitan Sydney, Australia.

pmc-11418622.title: Histopathological changes in testicular lesions in cats
pmc-11418622.creator: Fraser I Hill, May PY Tse, Steve W Mills, Jeanine R Sandy, Ibrahim Elsohaby, Vanessa R Barrs
pmc-11418622.description: ObjectivesThe aim of this retrospective study was to describe the neoplastic and non-neoplastic lesions seen on histopathological examination of cat testes in Hong Kong between 2018 and 2024.MethodsA total of 26 single or dual testes samples were collected from 18 cats by veterinarians at 14 veterinary clinics and submitted for histopathological examination.

pmc-11510139.title: Enhanced Thermoelectric Performance of SnTe via Introducing Resonant Levels
pmc-11510139.creator: Manman Yang, Jin Jia, Haijun Yu, Yimin Li, Lu Han, Hairui Sun, Haowen Jia, Yuanyuan Zhu
pmc-11510139.description: SnTe has emerged as a non-toxic and environmentally friendly alternative to the high-performance thermoelectric material PbTe, attracting significant interest in sustainable energy applications. In our previous work, we successfully synthesized high-quality SnTe with reduced thermal conductivity under high-pressure conditions. Building on this, in this work, we introduced indium (In) doping to further decrease thermal conductivity under high pressure.

pmc-11547157.title: In Vitro vs. In Vivo Transcriptomic Approach Revealed Core Pathways of Nitrogen Deficiency Response in Tea Plant (Camellia sinensis (L.) Kuntze)
pmc-11547157.creator: Lidiia Samarina, Lyudmila Malyukova, Songbo Wang, Aleksandr Bobrovskikh, Alexey Doroshkov, Ruset Shkhalakhova, Karina Manakhova, Natalia Koninskaya, Alexandra Matskiv, Alexey Ryndin, Elena Khlestkina, Yuriy Orlov, Abir U Igamberdiev
pmc-11547157.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). For the first time, we used an in vitro vs. in vivo experimental design to reveal core pathways under nitrogen deficiency (ND) in an evergreen tree crop. These pathways were related to lignin biosynthesis, cell redox homeostasis, the defense response to fungus, the response to Karrikin, amino acid transmembrane transport, the extracellular region, the cellular protein catabolic process, and aspartic-type endopeptidase activity.

pmc-11644144.title: CASSAD: Chroma-Augmented Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection for Conveyor Belt Idlers
pmc-11644144.creator: Fahad Alharbi, Suhuai Luo, Abdullah Alsaedi, Sipei Zhao, Guang Yang, Yongbo Li, Bing Li, Khandaker Noman, Teng Wang
pmc-11644144.description: Idlers are essential to conveyor systems, as well as supporting and guiding belts to ensure production efficiency. Proper idler maintenance prevents failures, reduces downtime, cuts costs, and improves reliability. Most studies on idler fault detection rely on supervised methods, which depend on large labelled datasets for training.

pmc-12623548.title: Letter to the Editor Regarding ‘Profile of Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease: Mapping Across Different Indian Populations (MAP Study)’
pmc-12623548.creator: Rishabh Bose, Kalyani Sridharan, Rohit Gupta
pmc-12623548.description: f MASLD across India. However, we would like to discuss several methodological and interpretative issues that warrant caution. First, the study’s retrospective, multicentre design across 105 clinics lacked uniform data standardization, which may introduce variability. The baseline metabolic characteristics of the screened population were not clearly reported, leaving uncertainty about participants’ metabolic risk profiles.

pmc-12657608.title: Use of doxorubicin and trabectedin in low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma: A case report
pmc-12657608.creator: Délya Valcourt-Gendron, Basile Tessier-Cloutier, Xing Zeng, Reitan Ribeiro, Shuk On Annie Leung, Victoria Mandilaras, Lili Fu, Tuyet Nhung Ton Ton Nu, Lara Richer, Lucy Gilbert, Laurence Bernard
pmc-12657608.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Highlights•Advanced LG-ESS are often treated with hormonal therapy.•In cases refractory to hormonal therapies, treatment options are limited.•This case is the first reported instance of LG-ESS achieving partial response with doxorubicin-trabectedin therapy.Keywords: Doxorubicin, Low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma, Recurrence, Trabectedin Introduction Low-grade endometrial stromal sarcomas (LG-ESS) are the most common type of endometrial stromal tumor (EST), accounting for less than 1 % of all uterine malignancies.

pmc-12700100.title: METTL3 and METTL14 determine human neural fate specifications
pmc-12700100.creator: Yanqi Zhang, Jitian Zhang, Huaisong Lin, Junwei Wang, Qianyu Chen, Tiancheng Zhou, Qi Xing, Guangjin Pan, Yongli Shan
pmc-12700100.description: METTL3/METTL14, the canonical methyltransferase complex modifying N6-methyladenosine (m6A) on mRNAs, plays critical roles in development and various diseases. However, its precise functions in specifying neural fate from human embryonic stem cells (hESCs) remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate, using an inducible knockout system, that METTL3/METTL14 deletion impairs the generation of neural progenitor cells (NPCs) from hESCs.

pmc-12794105.title: Retrospective study of histomorphological examination of skin lesion biopsies and their clinical concordance: experience from a tertiary care hospital in India
pmc-12794105.creator: Tarang Patel, Gyanendra Singh, Vaishali Bhankhodia, Kesha Rachani, Avani Dangar, Jayshukh Berani, Yashdeep Pathania, Krupal Joshi, Deepa Shukla
pmc-12794105.description: Histopathological examination is a cornerstone in dermatological diagnosis, providing critical insights into the pathogenesis and classification of cutaneous disorders. This study aims to evaluate the concordance between clinical diagnoses and histopathological findings in skin lesion biopsies. This descriptive cross-sectional retrospective study analyzed 321 skin biopsies performed in a dermatology outpatient department.

pmc-13338384.title: For income or for recognition: a comparative study of happiness among employees in state-owned and private enterprises
pmc-13338384.creator: Chao Xu, Rongling Long, Jiangyin Wang, Mingyue Li
pmc-13338384.description: In China, state-owned enterprises (SOE) and private enterprises represent the two main sectors absorbing labor. While previous studies have extensively examined differences between these two types of enterprises in terms of market performance and human resource management, little attention has been paid to differences in employee well-being.

pmc-13385010.title: Empathy for pain persists across live two-way video interactions and viewing of prerecorded videos
pmc-13385010.creator: Jannik Heimann, Pauline Petereit, Anat Perry, Ulrike M. Krämer
pmc-13385010.description: The impact of digitally mediated social interaction on understanding others and sharing their emotions has not been thoroughly investigated. We examined how live, video-mediated interaction, as opposed to watching a prerecorded video, affects behavioral, neural, and physiological aspects of empathy for pain. Thirty-five observers watched targets undergoing painful electric stimulation in an electroencephalogram study.
